title: What If the Moon Vanished Tonight? 🌙 #shorts
description: What would actually happen if the Moon disappeared? Tides, darkness, and a wobbling Earth. Follow for a new What If every day! #whatif #space #science #shorts

scenes.say: What if the Moon vanished tonight?
First, the night sky goes dark. No moonlight. Just stars.
Then the oceans change. The Moon's gravity pulls on our seas, and creates most of our tides.
Without it, tides shrink to about one third.
Tide pools that crabs and shorebirds depend on could slowly dry out.
Corals that spawn by the full moon? They'd lose their calendar.
But the scariest part is slow. The Moon keeps Earth's tilt steady. Without it, over millions of years, our axis could wobble wildly.
Ice ages. Scorching summers. Total climate chaos.
So tonight, look up, and thank the Moon. Follow for a new what if every day!
